slot.brief: Alkyne chain undergoes selective reagent (Hg2+/H2SO4 hydration or Lindlar) then electrophilic substitution; pick the major product structure from a multi-step scheme.

stem: Propyne is treated successively with $\text{NaNH}_2$, $\text{CH}_3\text{I}$ and $\text{HgSO}_4/\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4/\text{H}_2\text{O}$. What is the major final product?

verdicts.working: NaNH₂ deprotonates propyne; CH₃I adds a methyl group to form but-2-yne. HgSO₄/H₂SO₄/H₂O hydrates it to butan-2-one.

working:
$\text{CH}_3\text{C}\equiv\text{CH}\xrightarrow{\text{NaNH}_2}\text{CH}_3\text{C}\equiv\text{C}^-\xrightarrow{\text{CH}_3\text{I}}\text{CH}_3\text{C}\equiv\text{CCH}_3$.\nHg$^{2+}$/acid hydration of but-2-yne gives $\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_2\text{CH}_3$.

Independent check: NaNH₂ deprotonates propyne; CH₃I adds a methyl group to form but-2-yne. HgSO₄/H₂SO₄/H₂O hydrates it to butan-2-one.
solution:
NaNH₂ deprotonates propyne, and the acetylide ion undergoes alkylation with CH₃I:
$$\text{CH}_3\text{C}\equiv\text{CH}\xrightarrow{\text{NaNH}_2,\,\text{CH}_3\text{I}}\text{CH}_3\text{C}\equiv\text{CCH}_3$$
Hydration of but-2-yne with HgSO₄/H₂SO₄/H₂O gives butan-2-one, $\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_2\text{CH}_3$.
